title: #COMICSGATE KINGS! ComicsGate Characters vs. VAMPIRES!
episode_summary: A roughly three-hour ComicsGate Kings panel and drawing show hosted by Ethan Van Sciver. The panel draws ComicsGate characters and vampires, discusses the Chrissie Mayr/Friday Night Tights fallout and cancellation dynamics, watches and mocks Sturgis's Japan and PokePark travel footage, continues general comics and creator conversation, then presents and attempts to auction the finished artwork. The closing promotes Shane Davis's Back Me Bro launch as an upcoming ComicsGate-wide push.

story_updates.title: Chrissie Mayr departure from Friday Night Tights
story_updates.summary: ComicsGate Kings devoted a sustained segment to Chrissie Mayr's departure. Ethan framed it as a consequence of the Melanie Mack/TheQuartering dispute and said the FNT side felt unable to bring her back. Other panelists questioned the practical value of waiting to be fired and described her fit with the show negatively. These are panel interpretations, not an independent confirmation of the employment arrangement.

evidence.note: Sustained panel discussion of the departure and surrounding conflict.

story_updates.summary: At the close, Ethan said the launch was approximately six days away and described it as an all-hands-on-deck ComicsGate event, providing direct evidence of ComicsGate Kings functioning as a promotional hub for the campaign.
